verdict.rationale: The API docs describe a JumpCloud Graph with 'indirect and directly bound objects', which implies resources can be bound through groups rather than only to individual users. Other docs mention bulk operations across groups and automated access changes across the identity lifecycle. Nothing explicitly documents dynamic or rule-based group membership, or group-based SSO app assignment. Missing for 10: explicit dynamic/rule-based group membership docs, explicit group-to-app assignment docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
